component.name: Zarya
component.summary: Your morning dashboard: system updates, weather, backups, and today's events

description.p: Zarya is a small GTK4 app for the first thing you do at the computer each morning: refresh and dist-upgrade your system (via zypper), update your flatpaks, and see a quick dashboard of the day — weather, backup status, and today's calendar events. Run it by hand, or enable "Start at login" so it runs itself once a day.

ul.li: Runs zypper refresh + dist-upgrade and flatpak update with a single graphical password prompt
Skips re-running if it already updated today; persistent success/failure status
Daily weather report (Open-Meteo) as an hourly temperature/humidity/rain table, with current temperature, "feels like", Environment Canada weather alerts, and the Air Quality Health Index
Backup status from Pereprava's rclone/rsync jobs, with a link to open it
Today's Google Calendar events and due dates
Desktop notification, run history, and a "Preview" dry-run before committing to a real update
System tray icon; optional autostart at login runs quietly in the background instead of opening a window

description.p: "Quiet Ember". A real system tray icon — launching at login now starts hidden in the tray and runs quietly instead of always opening a window; click the tray icon to show it, "Quit Zarya" to actually exit. Weather (including alerts and air quality) now auto-refreshes every hour.

"Amber Watch". Environment Canada weather alerts and the current Air Quality Health Index on the weather panel, and a real fix for the Cancel button — it sent an unforwardable signal that could leave the real update process running on the host after cancelling. To-do sidebar now matches the update log's Fondwave styling.

"Amber Horizon". Current temperature and "feels like" on the weather panel, a frozen-column hourly table that scrolls on a plain wheel and centers on now, a persistent to-do sidebar, desktop notifications, run history, a "Preview" dry-run button, and a "What's New" panel. Every status now pairs an icon with its color, not color alone.

First release, "Coral Dawn". A daily update runner (zypper + flatpak, one password prompt) that grew into a small morning dashboard: an hourly weather table, Pereprava backup status, and today's Google Calendar events, each collapsible with an at-a-glance status icon. First-run onboarding wizard for city and calendar setup.
